description: This is a JavaScript source file implementing an aggregation function for agent usage and cost data across session_tracking and llm-costs collections in a MongoDB database. It processes session data, normalizes currency strings, and combines results to produce a summary of agent costs and token usage, supporting filtering by tenant, project, and date range.

methods.name: toNumberSafe(value)
methods.description: Utility function that safely parses currency-like strings and other inputs into numbers, handling formats like "$0.108255" and removing currency symbols and commas.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost( db, { tenant_id, project_id, from, to, limit = 50, offset = 0, } = {} )
methods.description: Main public method that aggregates agent costs and usage tokens from session_tracking and llm-costs collections, applying optional filters for tenant, project, and date range, then merges and sorts the results to produce a paginated summary.
